text:
maria: uploaded new iterate for model catalog compare: https://redwood.design/figma/model-catalog-compare-v4. quick look pls — focus filters + pin flow.

tony: skimmed it. love the condensed table. can we make the filter chip row wrap so long filter sets don't push content off-screen?

lee: wrap + allow an inline "more" collapsed chip group. also suggest a cheap affordance for saved filter presets — a star icon next to the filters bar.

rachel: Pin UX thought: right now pin is in the kebab menu. users expect a one-click action. put a small pin button at row end with a confirmation toast + undo.

omar: agree. show the pinned state prominently in the row: a tiny pill that reads "Pinned: v1.3" and includes a tooltip explaining scope (route vs org).

cy: performance badges — current color dots won't pass contrast. recommend: show metric label + numeric value + tiny icon, e.g. "⚡ P50: 28ms". icon+text keeps meaning without color reliance.

maria: good call. can we abbreviate to "P50 28ms" to save space and show full text on hover?

tony: +1 for abbreviations. also let's support column hiding via a right-most chevron menu (user can toggle columns like memory, cost). default columns: p50, p95, t/s, cost/1k.

lee: on narrow widths collapse to stacked rows: model meta on top line, metrics stacked underneath. mobile flow could be a compare modal when you select models.

rachel: accessibility: table needs role=grid, proper aria-colindex, aria-sort on headers. keyboard: tab goes into table, arrows navigate cells, Enter opens model details. add focus styles for badges as they reveal sparklines.

omar: copy nits: CTA text "Pin version" vs "Lock version". for enterprise maybe "Lock serving version" but short "Pin" is friendlier. maybe contextual label depending on user tier.

cy: for pin confirmation, don't block flow with modal. show inline toast with link "View rollout options" that opens a modal with traffic split / fallback. include an "Undo" action.

maria: agree — inline toast + optional advanced modal. also need a small badge denoting quantization/opt status (e.g., "Q4" or "FP16") next to version. hover to expand.

tony: visual density — current row height 64px. if we add badges swap to 2-line rows at 48px single-line, 72px two-line. keeps table readable without horizontal scroll.

lee: interactions for badges: hover shows tiny tooltip with exact numbers + 7d sparkline. keyboard focus should reveal same in an aside panel for screen readers.

rachel: saved filters: support query-string deep links so users can share filter state. also show a small "Shared" indicator if a preset is org-shared.

omar: sorting: allow custom weighted sort (slider sliders in a tiny modal). default sorts: latency, cost, throughput. users can create a custom composite and save it.

cy: design tokens reminder: use existing status tokens from design-system (info/warn/error), but don't rely on color alone. give badges accessible names and aria-labels like "Latency p50 28 milliseconds".

maria: api check — front-end needs p50, p95, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1k, mem_bytes, quant_label. @tony can you confirm backend fields?

tony: backend exposes p50_ms, p95_ms, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1k_cents, memory_bytes, quantization. should be fine, will add alias layer if needed.

lee: implementation note: for sparklines we'll pull 7d latency samples from /metrics endpoint; add a small cache to avoid hitting metrics on every hover.

rachel: mobile compare: let users pick up to 3 models and open a vertical compare modal that lists metrics stacked — more readable than compressed table. include CTA to pin from modal.

omar: UX edgecase: when pinned version is no longer available (deleted/trimmed), display "Pinned (retired)" and show suggested replacements. add a small migration flow.

cy: color contrasts: replace red/yellow/green-only badges with icon+label and use 3 distinct icons that also have text. run with axe after prototyping.

maria: action items: 1) update figma with sticky filter row + wrapping chips + row-level pin + two-line variant, 2) swap badges to icon+abbrev text and add hover details, 3) add aria/grid and keyboard nav notes, 4) add saved filters + query param deep link, 5) mobile compare modal mock, 6) link API field names in the spec.

tony: i'll follow up on API aliases and add the swagger link to the ticket.

lee: i'll draft the keyboard nav PRD and include screen reader examples.

rachel: i'll do a quick a11y pass once mock is updated.

omar: i'll prototype the inline toast + modal flow for pin.

ui-bot: FYI — component tokens used in the mock must be released in design-system v1.12. Open PR: https://git.redwood.ai/design-system/pulls/214

maria: thanks all. i'll update Figma and ping again for a quick walkthrough tomorrow 11am PT.

cy: :thumbsup:

tony: :eyes:

maria: done for now, thanks!
